name: nabla-game
description: Online version of Nabla Operator Game (https://nablagame.com/) - made with Rust/WASM
author: inferrinizzard

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --lib --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nabla_game.wasm --out-dir pkg --out-name index --target bundler
scripts.build: yarn clean && rustup default stable && yarn build:wasm && webpack --mode=production
scripts.start: yarn clean && yarn build:wasm && webpack serve --mode=development --live-reload --watch-files=src --open --hot
